name: Alex Harz
biography: Passionate about filmmaking & adventure, with a love for being on either side of the camera, Alex has been fortunate enough to have developed a well-versed set of acting, production, writing, directing and communication skills over the years. Combined with a solid foundation in international business, marketing, PR and event management, Alex utilizes his broad range of experience to enhance & maximize the potential of the projects he is involved in. From feature films to documentaries, from improvised comedy & radio to international sports marketing, Alex takes great joy in working on a wide range of productions.
